subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman in <Picture 1>, with fair skin, delicate features, dark eyes, and long black hair tied into a high ponytail with a few loose strands framing her face; she wears an iridescent lilac-and-white magical-girl costume made of a white fitted bodice, a layered holographic lilac mini skirt with a starry sheen, a sheer lavender hooded cape, thin silver waist belts set with blue gemstones, white gloves, and white knee-high heeled boots.
<Subject 2> is the faceted cyan crystal set into the chest of <Subject 1>'s costume in <Picture 1>, a pointed gemstone that emits a soft pulsing glow with rainbow refraction.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is an eight-second, four-shot live-action sequence following <Subject 1> from a plain room to a crowded cosplay convention: she gathers and fixes her ponytail, steps out to the curb and hails a taxi, arrives inside the packed venue, and the camera finally settles behind her back and pulls out to reveal the crowd filling the hall.

detailed_description:
The target video is live-action with a glossy idol-documentary look, soft directional key light, shallow depth of field, and cool lilac highlights over neutral tones.
[Shot 1] A medium close shot frames <Subject 1> against a plain warm-white wall, her black high ponytail and iridescent lilac costume filling most of the frame. She raises both hands, gathers a loose strand of hair away from her cheek, and tucks it back into the ponytail tie, then runs her gloved fingers along her crown to smooth the hair. The sheer lavender cape slides over her shoulders, and the cyan crystal on her chest, <Subject 2>, pulses once with a soft rainbow flare. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as she tilts her chin down, brushes one hand over the fall of her holographic skirt to settle it, lifts her eyes, and holds a composed, confident expression.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a medium-wide shot on a city sidewalk in soft late-afternoon light, apartment facades and parked scooters behind her. <Subject 1> walks away from the building entrance with the sheer cape trailing behind her boots, stops at the curb, and raises her right arm to hail a taxi. A white taxi slows and pulls to the curb with its brake lights glowing, and the rear door swings open. She steps in, gathers her skirt over the seat, and pulls the door shut as the camera holds a static shot on the curb.
[Shot 3] At 00:04.200, the shot cuts to a wide shot inside a large convention hall, with high ceilings, hanging banners, glowing LED booth walls, and dense crowds in varied cosplay costumes moving in every direction. <Subject 1> enters from frame left and walks between the booths; the camera tracks her at chest height, keeping her centered while people in armor, robes, and wigs stream past her and a few visitors turn their heads toward her costume. The crystal on her chest flickers with reflected booth light as she scans the hall.
[Shot 4] At 00:06.200, the shot cuts to a medium shot directly behind <Subject 1>: her back, her high ponytail, the hood of the sheer lavender cape, and the pointed white heels of her boots occupy the left third of the frame. The camera pulls out with large amplitude at slow speed, and the hall opens up behind her, revealing hundreds of cosplayers and visitors filling the floor, colorful costumes and raised phones scattered through the crowd, and overhead booth lights fading into the far end of the venue. She keeps walking forward, slightly out of focus against the sharp crowd.

overall_soundscape:
A quiet room tone with faint fabric rustle and hair sliding through fingers in the opening shot. Outdoors, light traffic hum, distant scooters, a taxi's engine approaching, the hiss of brakes, and a car door opening and closing. Inside the venue, dense layered crowd chatter, laughter, echoing footsteps on concrete, camera shutters, and occasional booth announcements continue through the final shot.

non_diegetic_music:
A bright synth-pop groove at a moderate tempo with a steady four-on-the-floor kick, plucked arpeggios, and a warm bass line. A soft cymbal lift lands on the venue reveal as the strings swell slightly before the video ends.
